title: gypsophila perfoliata subsp. ilerdensis
intro: Gypsophila perfoliata subsp. ilerdensis, commonly known as Iberian baby's breath, is a plant species in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant is said to have therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antiseptic, and antiparasitic effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Iberian baby's breath for medicinal purposes.
